summary.text: Mark Pearson is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2016.

paragraphs.text: Pearson chaired the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee in the 2021-2022 session and the Children and Family Law Committee in the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.
